import json
from pathlib import Path
data=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads')
st=json.loads((data/'operation-state.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cat=json.loads((data/'public-groups.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')).get('groups',{})
out=[]
for key,val in st.get('joined_groups',{}).items():
 if not isinstance(val,dict) or val.get('account')!=2: continue
 handle=key[2:] if key.startswith('2:') else key
 item=cat.get(handle,cat.get(handle.casefold(),{}))
 out.append({'handle':handle,'title':item.get('title') if isinstance(item,dict) else None,'join_status':val.get('status'),'dialog_confirmed':val.get('status')=='verified_existing_member'})
print('ACCOUNT_TWO_GROUPS',json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
print('READ_ONLY_DONE')
